title: ERCA Compendium of Decisions: What is it?
text:
Published On - December 28, 2022

The Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) Regional Competition Authority (ERCA) Compendium of Decisions is an important resource for businesses, competition practitioners, and other stakeholders in the ECOWAS region. The Compendium is a compilation of ERCA’s decisions in cases involving competition and consumer protection, and it offers valuable insights into the application of competition law and policy in the ECOWAS region.

The ERCA Compendium of Decisions promotes transparency and consistency in the application of competition law and policy, which is one of its primary benefits. By making these decisions accessible to the public, ERCA ensures that businesses and other stakeholders are aware of the legal and regulatory framework within which they operate and how it has been applied in specific cases. This can help level the playing field and encourage a more competitive business climate in the region.

The ERCA Compendium of Decisions is also a valuable source of guidance and information for competition practitioners, attorneys, and other experts in the field. By examining these decisions, these professionals can gain a deeper comprehension of the principles and policies that underpin competition law and policy in the ECOWAS region, as well as how they have been applied in specific cases. This can help them better advise clients and stakeholders, as well as contribute to the regional development of competition policy.

Overall, the ERCA Compendium of Decisions is a valuable resource that promotes transparency, uniformity, and comprehension of competition law and policy in the ECOWAS region. It is an indispensable resource for businesses, competition practitioners, and other parties attempting to navigate the region’s complex legal and regulatory landscape.
